messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 PAGE 0% 5xx observed for enterprise customer 'Palisade' on dedicated VPC palisade-dedicated-ap-sg1 (ap-southeast-1). Spike began ~2048901000. Threshold: 12% 5xx over 5m. Paging oncall rotation.

arjun (oncall): ack. joining bridge and grabbing metrics.

arjun (oncall): summary so far: palisade requests showing ~45% 502/503, tail latency > 3s, retries causing client timeouts. Not a full outage but high customer impact.

opsbot: Alert link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/2048901234 1-runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-vpc-5xx

arjun (oncall): running `kubectl -n dedicated-palisade get pods -l app=model-worker -o wide` -> several model-worker pods in CrashLoopBackOff and some with status OOMKilled.

arjun (oncall): tail of model-worker logs: ```
2026-04-02T03:10:12Z model-worker[pid:4432] ERROR allocator: failed to reserve workspace 1.6G for qkv buffers
2026-04-02T03:10:12Z model-worker[pid:4432] ERROR runtime: OOM while allocating attention buffers
2026-04-02T03:10:13Z model-worker[pid:4432] INFO worker exiting due to OOM
```

mel (sre): joining. quick note: Palisade is on a reserved dedicated VPC with strict tenant isolation. Impact is customer-facing only (no cross-tenant leak).

nina (eng): recent deploy note: deploy-bot shows runtime 2.3.4 pushed at 2048899000 with a quantization change enabling `q8_legacy` profile by default for some models. Could increase peak workspace for certain long-context workloads.

deploy-bot: recent deploys: runtime v2.3.4 (commit be8f2) -> deployed to palisade-dedicated-ap-sg1 at 2048899000 by nina (eng).

arjun (oncall): mitigation options: 1) toggle quant profile back to `q4_opt` for palisade 2) scale out dedicated pool (burst nodes) 3) quarantine noisy tenant if a single tenant is responsible.

mel (sre): I'll start with safe isolation + scale. Alex is on vacations so I'm leading the bridge. @arjun please collect heap profiles and eviction metrics; @nina can we flip the quant flag via config first?

nina (eng): yes, we can flip `DEFAULT_QPROFILE=q4_opt` via configmap rollout without code revert. Preparing rollout now.

opsbot: `configmap apply --name palisade-runtime --set DEFAULT_QPROFILE=q4_opt --rollout` triggered by nina (eng).

arjun (oncall): applied tenant-level throttle for suspected noisy tenant palisade-tenant-07: `throttle-tenant --tenant palisade-tenant-07 --qps 6`

rick (solutions): logged with support: Palisade CSM reports customer saw intermittent failed batch jobs between 03:09 and 03:42 local time, some client retries. They want an interim note and will likely request SLA credit.

claire (acct mgr): drafting message to Palisade CSM: "We observed a transient runtime memory allocation regression in your dedicated environment causing elevated 502/503 responses between 03:09 and 03:42 (ap-southeast-1). We have applied a conservative quantization profile, scaled additional capacity, and isolated a noisy tenant. We are preparing an internal RCA and will follow up with a proposed credit consistent with your SLA." Any phrasing tweaks?

nina (eng): add that we've preserved tenant isolation and no external data access occurred.

mel (sre): post-change metrics: after config flip + throttle + +2 nodes, 5xx rate dropped to ~2% in the past 8m. Continuing to watch.

arjun (oncall): timeline so far: ```
03:09 Alert fires: high 5xx for palisade-dedicated-ap-sg1
03:10 Initial triage: model-worker OOMs found across nodes
03:18 Throttle applied to palisade-tenant-07 at gateway
03:22 Autoscaler override +2 nodes requested
03:26 DEFAULT_QPROFILE flipped to q4_opt via configmap rollout
03:34 Error rate back to nominal (~<3%)
03:42 Customer reports degraded window ends
03:47 Bridge moved to watch mode
```

claire (acct mgr): SLA/credit note: Palisade has 99.9% uptime SLA for dedicated pools. Impact window ~33 minutes. I'll compute pro-rata credit (minutes impacted / monthly minutes * monthly reserved fee). Tentative: credit equal to ~1.5 hours reserved capacity or pro-rata refund; will confirm with billing and legal.

nina (eng): root cause hypotheses: quant profile default `q8_legacy` increases temporary workspace preallocations for attention kernels on long sequences; combined with Palisade's long-context usage this pushed nodes to OOM. Repro attempts in staging with real traces reproduces OOM. Preparing revert PR and config-gate to prevent auto-enable. PR #2420 opened.

mel (sre): action items assigned: arjun -> collect heap profiles, pod eviction and node memory metrics; nina -> PR + block auto-enable, produce repro artifacts; mel -> postmortem timeline + observability gaps; claire -> customer comms + early credit calc; rick -> coordinate with Palisade CSM for staged verification.

opsbot: Incident bridge: https://meetings.redwood/incidents/2048901234

arjun (oncall): oncall handoff note: mel is taking lead. I'll pass logs and runbook link to postmortems and handoff to mel at 2048901600.

claire (acct mgr): interim note ready to send to Palisade CSM. Will include timeline and contact for escalation. Target: send in 10m.

rick (solutions): ask Palisade if they'd like a proposed maintenance window to validate the fix in their non-prod sandbox before we flip in prod. Offer guided session.

nina (eng): PR #2420 created to add config gate and revert quant-profile default. Marked as hotfix candidate if required.

deploy-bot: flagged deploys for palisade-dedicated-ap-sg1: runtime v2.3.4 (be8f2) -> deployed at 2048899000 by nina (eng).

mel (sre): incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2048902740 after 30m of stable metrics. Moving to watch.

claire (acct mgr): customer follow-up schedule: interim note now, RCA draft in 24h, full RCA with remediation and credit proposal in 72h, exec summary to Palisade exec sponsor within 5 business days. Will coordinate legal/billing for credit amounts.

arjun (oncall): creating RCA skeleton now and will paste initial timeline + logs to #postmortems in 4h.

mel (sre): final watch instructions: keep throttles for 2h, monitor OOM kill metric, remove throttle only after 6h stable or on call from eng. Closing active bridge at 2048902987; thread will remain for RCA follow-up. Great work all. :clap:"
